clone_mode: shallow (--depth 1); blobless partial (--filter=blob:none) where a sparse pattern is declared

repos.name: shadcn-ui
repos.purpose: UI component layer (Radix + Tailwind). Installed as a package; cloned to read component composition and the registry pattern.

repos.name: drizzle-orm
repos.purpose: ORM. Installed. Reference for SQLite driver internals and schema authoring conventions.

repos.name: vercel-ai
repos.purpose: AI SDK. Installed. Reference for zod-schema structured output, streaming, and multi-provider fallback wiring.

repos.name: maplibre-gl-js
repos.purpose: Map renderer. Installed. Reference for style spec, layer expressions, raster/vector source setup.

repos.name: planetiler
repos.purpose: OSM to vector tilesets in Java. Optional path to self-hosting our tiles. Reference for the OSM tag schema our harvest should target.

repos.name: opening-hours-php
repos.purpose: Canonical opening-hours library (the npm `opening_hours` package is a port). Reference for correct OSM opening_hours semantics: exceptions, week specs, holidays, overnight spans.

repos.name: better-auth
repos.purpose: Auth. Installed. Reference for the Drizzle/SQLite adapter and session handling.

repos.name: turf
repos.purpose: Geo operations. Installed. Reference for distance, bbox, along-line and buffer implementations.

repos.name: faker
repos.purpose: Deterministic seed-data generation for reviews and provider profiles.

repos.name: nextjs-boilerplate
repos.purpose: Repo hygiene reference: layered src layout, env validation, ESLint/Prettier, Vitest, Playwright, CI wiring. Adopt the structure, not the code.

repos.name: openrouteservice-js
repos.purpose: Routing client. Reference for the provider-adapter + fallback-chain pattern and isochrone request shapes.

repos.name: routingpy
repos.purpose: Provider-agnostic routing facade. Reference for the adapter interface our travel.ts mirrors.

repos.name: fastapi-fullstack-template
repos.purpose: Proven full-stack layout and auth-shell conventions. Layout patterns only.

repos.name: medusa
repos.purpose: Durable workflow/step engine. We borrow the idempotent-step + compensation pattern for the booking state machine and availability decrements. NOT installed.

repos.name: pyvrp
repos.purpose: State-of-the-art VRP solver. Reference for how time windows, capacity and precedence are modelled. Validates our packer formulation. NOT installed.

repos.name: galton
repos.purpose: Lightweight Node isochrone server. Reference for travel-time-contour computation.

repos.name: osrm-isochrone
repos.purpose: Drivetime isochrones from OSM via OSRM. Reference for isochrone generation.

repos.name: docker-valhalla
repos.purpose: Valhalla in Docker. Multimodal routing INCLUDING transit - the honest fix for Mumbai train-vs-car. Optional stretch. NOT installed.

repos.name: xrec
repos.purpose: EMNLP 2024. LLMs for explainable recommendation. Academic backing for our why-ledger and provenance labels. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: crslab
repos.purpose: Conversational recommender toolkit. Source of the user-simulator eval idea and CRS metrics. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: crs-papers
repos.purpose: Conversational recommender paper list. Related-work slide. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: recbole
repos.purpose: Standard RecSys library. Source of Recall@K / NDCG@K / MRR metric methodology for our eval table. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: recsys-datasets
repos.purpose: Public RecSys datasets. Reference for benchmark design in our eval harness. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: pepler
repos.purpose: TOIS 2023. Personalized prompt learning for explainable recommendation. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: pgpr
repos.purpose: Explainable recommendation via knowledge-graph reasoning. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: awesome-recsys-papers
repos.purpose: Survey list. Positioning slide for the deck. The repo is 1.16 GB of archived media, so we take the README only. CITED, not installed.

repos.name: tf-ranking
repos.purpose: REJECTED: learning-to-rank needs training data we do not have. Interpretable features + a contextual bandit are more honest and demo better.

repos.name: allrank
repos.purpose: REJECTED: same reason as tf-ranking, plus a PyTorch dependency we cannot justify in a 1-week TypeScript build.

repos.name: ptranking
repos.purpose: REJECTED: same reason. Kept so the team can see we evaluated the LTR option and why we declined it.

repos.name: google-maps-scraper
repos.purpose: REJECTED ON COMPLIANCE GROUNDS: scrapes Google Maps in breach of their ToS. It would have filled our ratings gap, but we do not use it. Our equivalent is provider-submitted data plus clearly-labelled LLM inference. Cloned so the whole team can see exactly what we declined and why.

repos.name: medusa-as-dep
repos.purpose: POINTER: we borrow Medusa's workflow pattern but do not install it (needs its own server + Postgres, and e-commerce is the wrong domain shape for bookable experiences).

repos.name: recbole-as-dep
repos.purpose: POINTER: we borrow RecBole's metric methodology but do not install it (Python + ML deps, and we have a 2-day TypeScript deliverable).

repos.name: opentripplanner
repos.purpose: THE reference for multi-modal routing. RAPTOR transit algorithm over GTFS combined with street walking/biking/car. This is the honest answer to Mumbai's train-vs-car problem, and the model our travel.ts facade is shaped around.

repos.name: pretix
repos.purpose: Event ticketing done properly: capacity-limited availability, vouchers/quota rules, order state machines, and a separate presale (buyer) vs eventbox (organiser) app split. The reference for our provider-side booking loop.

repos.name: trek
repos.purpose: Self-hosted travel planner, TypeScript, 14k stars, actively developed. Reference for trip collaboration, itinerary UX, and a comparable TS stack.

repos.name: adventurelog
repos.purpose: Self-hostable travel tracker and trip planner. Reference for the visit/place/segment data model and itinerary timeline UX.

repos.name: trip-tracker
repos.purpose: Minimalist POI map tracker and trip planner, self-hosted, MIT. Reference for a deliberately narrow scope: map, POIs, trip log.

repos.name: trustroots
repos.purpose: Travellers community for hosting and meeting people. Reference for the traveller-to-local matching half of the marketplace, including trust and reputation mechanics.

repos.name: rox
repos.purpose: Non-profit hospitality network: hosts and travellers connecting, plus find-a-stay. Reference for trust, verification and community signalling on both sides of our marketplace.

repos.name: id-tagging-schema
repos.purpose: Authoritative OSM tagging schema. Defines the exact semantics of the tags our harvest depends on - opening_hours grammar, wheelchair, fee, capacity, cuisine, diet:*, indoor. This is what our zod schemas must match.

repos.name: osmnx
repos.purpose: 5.8k stars, the standard library for downloading and modelling OSM data by bbox or polygon. Reference for query construction, tag filters and network caching in our harvest scripts.

repos.name: graphhopper
repos.purpose: Routing engine with isochrone generation, GTFS transit import and custom time-dependent weighting. Reference for our congestion multiplier and isochrone-first filtering.

repos.name: pelias
repos.purpose: Self-hostable geocoder (MIT), the usual alternative to depending on Nominatim's public instance. Fallback for our address and place search.

repos.name: photon
repos.purpose: Lightweight OSM geocoder (Apache-2.0). Second geocoder option, simpler to self-host than Pelias.

repos.name: orama
repos.purpose: 11k stars, in-process full-text search for JS/TS with typo tolerance and faceting. The live alternative to SQLite FTS5 in our retrieval stage - we compare the two before committing.

repos.name: opentraveldata
repos.purpose: Catalogue of open travel/tourism data sources. The repo is 2 GB of data files so we take the README, which is the list we actually wanted. Cited, not installed.

repos.name: plan-it
repos.purpose: HIGHEST CONCEPTUAL RELEVANCE. A deterministic itinerary engine with web research and OPTIONAL AI on top - the same split we chose (LLM never in the decision path). Check how it structures the engine/LLM boundary.

repos.name: routemind
repos.purpose: RAG + embeddings + OR-Tools + Google Maps. Our reference for how people actually wire a real constraint solver into a travel app, and where the seams are.

repos.name: travel-ai-tai
repos.purpose: FastAPI + structured LLM output + preferences + ACCESSIBILITY. Accessibility is a graded PS factor and the one OSM barely populates. MIT.

repos.name: tripsage-ai
repos.purpose: Agentic planning with tools, memory and Supabase/pgvector. Reference for the memory layer and for how they scope agent tools. MIT, TypeScript.

repos.name: floattrip
repos.purpose: 79 stars. LangGraph + POI retrieval + ROUTE CLUSTERING + LLM itinerary. Their route clustering is the closest prior art to our packer.

repos.name: aitravelplanner
repos.purpose: 81 stars, 2023, mostly retired. A plain GPT-itinerary baseline. Useful as the 'naive LLM' comparison point in our write-up.

repos.name: mytripplanner
repos.purpose: Conversational travel agent covering routes, budget, hotels and restaurants. Reference for conversational UX and budget handling.

repos.name: ai-travel-assistant
repos.purpose: LangGraph with tools, memory, streaming and structured trip cards. Reference for streaming structured output over SSE.

repos.name: tripmate-ai
repos.purpose: Tiny (19 KB) LangGraph multi-agent planner. Useful only to see the multi-agent pattern we are deliberately NOT using, and why.

repos.name: voyagertripplanner
repos.purpose: Multi-agent planner with geolocation and India-focused travel dialogue. India-specific phrasing and intent patterns worth borrowing for NLU fixtures.

repos.name: uguiderag
repos.purpose: ACM SIGSPATIAL 2025. Four-stage pipeline: UGC -> structured Landscape/Activity/Atmosphere extraction -> dimension-aware retrieval -> LLM rerank -> cluster-aware spatial optimisation. Gives us our perception-dimension schema and per-dimension retrieval instead of one blended embedding.

repos.name: itinera
repos.purpose: arXiv 2402.07204, DEPLOYED IN PRODUCTION at the TuTu travel service with thousands of real users. Request Decomposition (granularity x specificity x attitude) plus cluster-then-route spatial optimisation. The production-validated source for our soft-constraint fields and our packing strategy. GPL-3.0.

repos.name: tripweaver
repos.purpose: LLM + Z3 SMT hybrid planner, including z3_temporal_scheduler_with_relaxation.py. THE upgrade over hand-rolled constraint assertions: a real satisfiability proof plus an unsat core that yields automatic minimal relaxation. Directly generates our relaxation ladder algorithmically.

repos.name: tripcraft
repos.purpose: TripCraft, ACL 2025 Main (Microsoft + IIT Bhubaneswar). The constraint-aware travel planning benchmark. Source of our five continuous evaluation metrics: Temporal, Attraction, Spatial, Ordering, Persona scores.

repos.name: ai-tour-meeting
repos.purpose: NTT Research. Persona-instantiated LLM agents hold a structured discussion to reach group consensus, instead of statically averaging preference vectors. The upgrade path for our group/traveler-type handling.

repos.name: nomadnote
repos.purpose: Local-first planner with a "Trip Stress Radar" scoring overload / rain-risk / anchor-pressure / transit-complexity 0-100 with concrete suggested fixes. Cleanest existing framing of a fatigue and buffer model. MIT.

repos.name: jauntai
repos.purpose: Multi-agent travel system: Supervisor Agent decomposes the query, Domain Guardrails filter unsafe or off-topic input, specialist sub-agents per domain, human-in-the-loop approval gate. Reference for our input-safety layer and orchestration shape. MIT.

repos.name: inkle
repos.purpose: Gemini-based planner with explicit pipeline nodes (Places -> Route -> Cost -> Synthesizer). Concrete shipped evidence that the staged-pipeline pattern is implementable, which is the core of our architecture claim.

repos.name: tourwise
repos.purpose: Academic capstone folding an ML-predicted crowd "Busyness Index" into itinerary scoring. Sourceable method for our crowd_fit ranking feature, which the plan needs grounding for. GPL-2.0, and a 387 MB repo so only the model and service code is kept.

repos.name: routemind-pritesh
repos.purpose: RAG + embeddings + OR-Tools + Google Maps. The masterplan flags this as a modest-scope project we should NOT quote as a benchmark without checking ourselves. Kept as a counter-example, not an authority.

repos.name: tourism-spot-baseline
repos.purpose: Academic hybrid content-based/collaborative-filtering tourism recommender. Useful ONLY as a baseline-quality comparison: static catalogue, no real-time constraints, same cold-start problem. GPL-3.0.

repos.name: tourism-recommendation
repos.purpose: 50 stars, classic content/collaborative-filtering tourism recommender over a Kaggle-style attraction dataset. Baseline comparison, not an architecture reference.

repos.name: tourism-recommendation-2
repos.purpose: Notebook-based tourism recommendation system. 153 MB almost entirely dataset, so only the notebooks and code are kept.

repos.name: ai-travelassistant-bala
repos.purpose: Small FastAPI-style AI travel assistant with an input.json and a generated report.md. Useful for comparing how a thin LLM wrapper differs from our engine-first design.

repos.name: trek-xaler1
repos.purpose: The Xaler1/TREK original named in the masterplan, kept alongside liketrek/TREK (the actively developed 14k-star fork we already have) so we can see what the fork diverged on. AGPL-3.0.
